channel.title: Wazuh Labs on Karim's Blog
channel.description: Recent content in Wazuh Labs on Karim's Blog

item.title: Lab 1 - Wazuh + Suricata IDS Setup
item.description: Setting up Wazuh SIEM with Suricata NIDS to detect port scans, SQL injection, XSS, and Tor connections using Emerging Threats rules.

item.title: Lab 2 - Malware Detection with Wazuh
item.description: Malware detection using Wazuh FIM, CDB hash lists, VirusTotal, Windows Defender log forwarding, and Sysmon for fileless malware detection.

item.title: Lab 3 - SetChain: AI + Blockchain Threat Detection
item.description: Graduation project: automated cybersecurity pipeline — Wazuh, Suricata, n8n, 5-layer AI (Isolation Forest + XGBoost + LLM), STIX 2.1, IPFS, and Hyperledger Fabric blockchain.
